# French Corporate Income Tax (IS) - Taux 2026

## Source
- LégiFiscal - "Taux IS 2026 : 25% normal, 15% PME jusqu'à 42 500 €"
- Verified: 2026

## Rates

| Category | Rate | Threshold |
|----------|------|-----------|
| Normal rate | 25% | All profits |
| SME reduced rate (PME) | 15% | Up to €42,500 of fiscal result |
| SME standard rate | 25% | Above €42,500 of fiscal result |

## SME Conditions
- Annual turnover below €10 million
- Fully owned by individuals (at least 75%) or by other SMEs meeting same criteria

The reduced rate is progressive, not a cliff: an eligible SME pays 15% on the
first €42,500 of fiscal result and 25% only on the excess. For example,
€60,000 of profit gives €42,500 × 15% + €17,500 × 25% = €10,750.

## History (for reference)
- 2021: 26.5% / 27.5% transitional rates
- 2022+: 25% normal rate, 15% reduced for SMEs up to €42,500
